_description: Curated site list for the RepixBridge smoke test. Each entry has a url, category, complexity rating (1-5), and notes. The runner visits each in order and runs the test suite. Sites are chosen to cover the fluidity surface area: landing pages, editorial, SaaS, e-commerce, docs, and a few edge cases.
_strategy: Web-builder sites (Framer, Webflow) are intentionally excluded. The project decided 2026-04-15 to stop trying to crack their animations — too hard, too fragile, too slow to pay off. Focus on simpler editable sites.
